readingOrder.description: One six-panel optics figure, three rows by two columns; no prose inside it.

rows: 同距离的点的像都变得足够清晰，即所谓景深增加。
投影仪　投影仪是用来在屏幕上获得物体放大的实像
的。物体可以是从后面照明的图片或幻灯片。投影仪器的结
构简图如图 183 所示。利用镜头 O 在屏幕上产生幻灯片 D 的
像。叫做聚光器的透镜组 K 用来把光源发出的光集中到幻灯
片上。镜头把照亮的幻灯片投影到屏幕上，从幻灯片到屏幕
使镜头靠近或者远离幻灯片，并同时改变投影仪到屏幕
间的距离就可以改变投影仪的放大率。
像透明物体一样，不透明的物体同样也可以用投影仪在
屏上成像。这样的仪器叫做反射映画器。为了得到不透明物

typography.description: 投影仪 is an inline bold lead-in on the first projector paragraph row, not a separate printed heading row.

boundaries.incoming: Page starts with the figure; first prose below its caption starts 同距离的点的像都变得足够清晰，即所谓景深增加。 Its leading 同 is not changed or supplemented from neighbouring-page pixels.
boundaries.outgoing: Last visible prose stops at 为了得到不透明物 with no closing punctuation; the object is incomplete.
boundaries.figure183: Referenced in projector prose, but there is no figure 183 on SOURCE208; only figure 182 is visible.

panels.lens: Vertical biconvex outline near x270, with top/bottom short horizontal end marks and four irregular oblique interior hatch groups.
panels.rays: Two rays leave A toward the upper/lower lens edges, then meet at a single point on the screen at A′.
panels.arrows: Both incident and both emergent segments have rightward directional arrowheads.
panels.crossings: No crossing before the screen; the two emergent rays meet on the screen.

panels.lens: Vertical biconvex outline near x860, end marks, four irregular oblique hatch groups.
panels.rays: Four rays start at A. Outer rays reach the lens rim and end at the upper/lower stop; inner rays pass the aperture and converge at A′ on the screen.
panels.arrows: Four rightward incident arrows and two rightward transmitted arrows.
panels.crossings: The transmitted inner pair meets on the screen.
panels.stop: Two solid vertical segments just right of the lens near x894, upper and lower separated by a central open gap; blocked outer-ray ends do not continue to the screen.
panels.imageExtent: Point on the screen, same sharp A case as the left panel with a narrowed admitted bundle.

panels.lens: Vertical biconvex outline near x276, end marks, four irregular oblique hatch groups.
panels.rays: Two rays from B reach upper/lower lens edges, then approach one another without meeting before the screen, striking it at two separated heights.
panels.arrows: Two incident and two emergent rightward arrows.
panels.crossings: No outgoing crossing before or on the screen.
panels.imageExtent: Separated screen endpoints; B′ is between the upper and lower intercept heights.

panels.lens: Vertical biconvex outline near x861, end marks, four irregular oblique hatch groups.
panels.rays: Four incident rays from B; outer two end at stop segments. Inner two pass the opening and hit the screen at two distinct heights, closer together than in б.
panels.arrows: Four rightward incident arrows and two rightward transmitted arrows.
panels.crossings: The inner pair does not cross before the screen; it remains separated there.
panels.stop: Upper/lower solid segments near x895, with a central clear gap bounded by the transmitted inner rays.
panels.imageExtent: Narrower but nonzero separation at B′; not an exact focal point.

panels.lens: Vertical biconvex outline near x283, end marks, four irregular oblique hatch groups.
panels.rays: Two incident rays reach upper/lower lens edges; the outgoing pair crosses near x426,y761 before reaching the screen, then diverges to two screen intercepts.
panels.arrows: Two incident arrows and two emergent arrows point rightward.
panels.crossings: One outgoing-ray crossing before the screen, not at C′.
panels.imageExtent: Nonzero separated intercepts on the screen after the crossing.

panels.lens: Vertical biconvex outline near x862, end marks, four irregular oblique hatch groups.
panels.rays: Four incident rays from C; outer rays terminate at upper/lower stop. Two transmitted inner rays cross near x1018,y750 before the screen and then reach two separated, closely spaced screen positions.
panels.arrows: Four rightward incident and two rightward transmitted arrows.
panels.crossings: One inner-ray crossing before the screen; narrowing is not replaced by an exact point on the screen.
panels.stop: Upper/lower solid segments near x895 with a central open gap; no outer ray transmitted through them.
panels.imageExtent: Reduced but nonzero screen separation at C′ after the crossing.

raw182.hatchingCaveat: A hatch group is a visible irregular short cluster, not an inferred count of straight hatch strokes; these pixel shapes must be preserved by RAW/SVG rather than regularized.
raw182.cropCompleteness: All six labels, primed labels, lens end marks, hatch patterns, rays, arrows, screens and three stop gaps are inside the raw crop. Figure caption and prose are outside it. Left C sits close to the left edge but its whole glyph remains visible. No neighbouring figure or prose intrudes.
raw182.notSourceFacts: No axis, tick, numerical dimension, focal-length label, modern panel caption or formula appears within the figure.
